Its next objective is to keep the key, approach the locked door, and toggle it open; doing so advances to u2 and earns the second shaping reward. u4: Absorbing failure: the agent dropped the key while the door was still closed, so key_lost fired before the door was opened. There is no further reward or recovery path in this RM; a successful policy must avoid dropping the key until after the door is open.
